def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    mean = 9
    std_dev = 2
    data_points = [5, 8, 13, 12, 7, 9, 10, 6, 11, 7]

    # Calculate the percentage within one standard deviation (7% to 11%)
    count_within_range = sum(
        mean - std_dev <= value <= mean + std_dev
        for value in data_points
    )
    answer = (count_within_range / len(data_points)) * 100

    # return answer
    return round(answer, 2)
